definitionEn:
n. a resident of a colony
a. of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony
a. of animals who live in colonies, such as ants
s. composed of many distinct individuals united to form a whole or colony
definitionZh: a. 殖民的, 殖民地的\n[法] 殖民地居民

example.text: The country gained independence after decades of colonial rule.
example.translationZh: 这个国家在数十年殖民统治后获得了独立。

definitionEn:
n. a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland; inhabitants remain nationals of their home state but are not literally under the home state's system of government
n. a group of organisms of the same type living or growing together
n. one of the 13 British colonies that formed the original states of the United States
n. a place where a group of people with the same interest or occupation are concentrated
definitionZh: n. 殖民地, 移民队\n[医] 菌(集)落, 菌丛; 移民区

example.text: The island served as a penal colony for more than fifty years.
example.translationZh: 这个岛屿作为流放地长达五十多年。

definitionEn: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect\nn. interest and variety and intensity\nn. the timbre of a musical sound
definitionZh: n. 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌\nvt. 把...涂上颜色, 粉饰, 使脸红, 歪曲\nvi. 变色

example.text: The documentary shows the war in living color, without hiding its horrors.
example.translationZh: 这部纪录片真实生动地展现了战争，毫不掩饰其恐怖。

phrase.translationZh: 栩栩如生地；真实生动地

definitionEn: s. so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
definitionZh: a. 巨大的, 巨像似的

example.text: The company made a colossal mistake by ignoring the warnings.
example.translationZh: 公司无视警告，犯下了一个巨大的错误。

definitionEn:
n. a line of units following one after another
n. a vertical glass tube used in column chromatography; a mixture is poured in the top and washed through a stationary substance where components of the mixture are adsorbed selectively to form colored bands
n. a vertical array of numbers or other information
n. anything that approximates the shape of a column or tower
definitionZh: n. 专栏, 圆柱, 纵队, 列, 柱形物\n[计] 列, 柱形图

example.text: She writes a weekly column for the local newspaper.
example.translationZh: 她为当地报纸撰写每周专栏。

definitionEn: n. an engagement fought between two military forces
definitionZh: n. 争斗, 战斗\nvi. 战斗, 争斗\nvt. 与...战斗, 与...斗争

example.text: The soldiers were trained for combat in difficult terrain.
example.translationZh: 士兵们接受了在复杂地形中作战的训练。

definitionEn: n. harvester that heads and threshes and cleans grain while moving across the field\nv. add together from different sources\nv. join for a common purpose or in a common action
definitionZh: v. (使)联合, (使)结合\nn. (企业的)联合, 联合收割机

example.text: The two companies decided to combine forces to develop the new technology.
example.translationZh: 两家公司决定联合力量来开发这项新技术。

definitionEn: n. a substance that can be burned to provide heat or power\na. capable of igniting and burning
definitionZh: a. 易燃的, 燃烧性的, 易动激情的\nn. 易燃物, 可燃物

example.text: The warehouse stores combustible materials such as paper, wood, and cardboard.
example.translationZh: 这个仓库储存纸张、木材和纸板等可燃材料。

definitionEn:
v. move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody
v. come to pass; arrive, as in due course
v. reach or enter a state, relation, condition, use, or position
v. to be the product or result
definitionZh: vi. 过来, 来, 到达, 出现, 开始\ninterj. 喂

example.text: I came across an old friend at the market yesterday.
example.translationZh: 昨天我在市场上偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

definitionEn: n. light and humorous drama with a happy ending
definitionZh: n. 喜剧, 有趣的事情

example.text: We watched a comedy show on TV last night and laughed the whole time.
example.translationZh: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个喜剧节目，全程都在笑。

definitionEn: n. (astronomy) a relatively small extraterrestrial body consisting of a frozen mass that travels around the sun in a highly elliptical orbit
definitionZh: n. 彗星

example.text: The comet became visible in the night sky as it approached the sun.
example.translationZh: 当彗星接近太阳时，它在夜空中变得可见。

definitionEn:
a. providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)
a. free from stress or conducive to mental ease; having or affording peace of mind
s. more than adequate
s. sufficient to provide comfort
definitionZh: a. 舒服的, 轻松的\nn. 盖被

example.text: These shoes are so soft that I can walk in them all day and still feel comfortable.
example.translationZh: 这双鞋非常柔软，我可以穿一整天走路，仍然觉得很舒服。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to or characteristic of comedy
definitionZh: n. 连环漫画, 喜剧演员, 滑稽的人\na. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜剧的

example.text: The serious play includes a scene of comic relief to lighten the mood.
example.translationZh: 这部严肃的戏剧中加入了一段喜剧性的调剂场面，以缓和气氛。

definitionEn: v. mark by some ceremony or observation\nv. call to remembrance; keep alive the memory of someone or something, as in a ceremony\nv. be or provide a memorial to a person or an event
definitionZh: vt. 纪念

example.text: The city will hold a candlelight vigil to commemorate the anniversary of the disaster.
example.translationZh: 这座城市将举行烛光守夜活动，以纪念那场灾难的周年。

definitionEn:
v. express approval of
v. present as worthy of regard, kindness, or confidence
v. give to in charge
v. express a good opinion of
definitionZh: vt. 嘉奖, 委托给, 推荐

example.text: The teacher commended her students for their hard work on the project.
example.translationZh: 老师表扬了学生们在这个项目上的努力。

definitionEn: n a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material
definitionZh: n. 注释, 评论, 说明\n[法] 注释, 评注, 评论

example.text: The former player provided live commentary during the football match.
example.translationZh: 这位前球员在足球比赛期间提供了现场评论。

definitionEn:
n. a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
a. connected with or engaged in or sponsored by or used in commerce or commercial enterprises
a. of or relating to commercialism
s. of the kind or quality used in commerce; average or inferior
definitionZh: a. 商业的, 商用的, 商品化的\nn. 商业广告节目

example.text: The film was a huge commercial success despite mixed reviews from critics.
example.translationZh: 尽管评论界褒贬不一，这部电影在商业上取得了巨大成功。

definitionEn: n a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
definitionZh: n. （电台或电视播放的）广告 ( commercial的名词复数 ); 以大众欣赏为目的谱写的乐曲

example.text: During the break, the channel showed several commercials for new cars.
example.translationZh: 在广告时段，这个频道播放了几则新车广告。

definitionEn:
n. the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action
n. an engagement by contract involving financial obligation
n. a message that makes a pledge
n. the official act of consigning a person to confinement (as in a prison or mental hospital)
definitionZh: n. 委托, 交押, 承担义务, 赞助\n[医] 院禁

example.text: She made a commitment to exercise every morning before work.
example.translationZh: 她承诺每天上班前晨练。

definitionEn: n. a special group delegated to consider some matter\nn. a self-constituted organization to promote something
definitionZh: n. 委员会\n[经] 委员会

example.text: She has served on the organizing committee for three years.
example.translationZh: 她已在组织委员会任职三年。

definitionEn:
a. belonging to or participated in by a community as a whole; public
a. having no special distinction or quality; widely known or commonly encountered; average or ordinary or usual
s. common to or shared by two or more parties
s. commonly encountered
definitionZh: a. 通常的, 共同的, 通俗的, 公共的\n[计] 公用块

example.text: It is common sense to lock your door when you leave the house.
example.translationZh: 出门时锁门是常识。

definitionEn: s. completely ordinary and unremarkable\ns. not challenging; dull and lacking excitement
definitionZh: n. 寻常事, 老生常谈, 普通的东西\na. 平凡的, 普通的

example.text: Traveling by train has become commonplace in this region.
example.translationZh: 在这个地区，乘火车出行已经变得很平常了。

definitionEn: n. the official name of some states in the United States (Massachusetts and Pennsylvania and Virginia and Kentucky) and associated territories (Puerto Rico)\nn. a world organization of autonomous states that are united in allegiance to a central power but are not subordinate to it or to one another
definitionZh: n. 共和国；联邦；国民整体

example.text: Many former British colonies are now members of the Commonwealth of Nations.
example.translationZh: 许多前英国殖民地现在是英联邦的成员。

definitionEn: n. the act of making a noisy disturbance
definitionZh: n. 骚动, 暴乱\n[医] 震荡

example.text: The sudden loud noise caused a commotion in the quiet library.
example.translationZh: 突然的巨响在安静的图书馆里引起了一阵骚动。

definitionEn: n. the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information\nn. something that is communicated by or to or between people or groups\nn. a connection allowing access between persons or places
definitionZh: n. 交流, 交通, 通讯\n[计] 通信

example.text: Clear and effective communication is essential for a successful team.
example.translationZh: 清晰有效的沟通对于团队的成功至关重要。

definitionEn:
n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work
v. exchange positions without a change in value
v. travel back and forth regularly, as between one's place of work and home
v. exchange a penalty for a less severe one
definitionZh: vt. 交换, 折偿, 减轻\nvi. 代偿, 经常乘车来往

example.text: Her daily commute takes about forty minutes by train.
example.translationZh: 她每天乘火车通勤大约需要四十分钟。

definitionEn: n. a passenger train that is ridden primarily by passengers who travel regularly from one place to another\nn. someone who travels regularly from home in a suburb to work in a city
definitionZh: n. 乘公共车辆上下班者, 月季票乘客\n[经] 非(当地)居民

example.text: She catches the 7 a.m. commuter train into the city every weekday.
example.translationZh: 她每个工作日都乘坐早上7点的通勤列车进城。

definitionEn:
n. a small cosmetics case with a mirror; to be carried in a woman's purse
n. a small and economical car
v. have the property of being packable or of compacting easily
a. closely and firmly united or packed together
definitionZh: a. 紧凑的, 紧密的, 简洁的\nvt. 使紧密结合, 压缩\nvi. 变坚实

example.text: She parked her compact car in the narrow space without any trouble.
example.translationZh: 她毫不费力地把自己的小型汽车停进了狭窄的车位。

definitionEn:
n an institution created to conduct business
n small military unit; usually two or three platoons
n the state of being with someone
n organization of performers and associated personnel (especially theatrical)
n a social or business visitor
n a social gathering of guests or companions
n a band of people associated temporarily in some activity
n crew of a ship including the officers; the whole force or personnel of a ship
n a unit of firefighters including their equipment
v be a companion to somebody
definitionZh: n. 公司, 企业；公司财产；伙伴（company的复数形式）

example.text: Several tech companies have opened offices in the city this year.
example.translationZh: 今年有几家科技公司在该市开设了办事处。

definitionEn: n. a friend who is frequently in the company of another\nn. a traveler who accompanies you\nn. one paid to accompany or assist or live with another
definitionZh: n. 朋友, 陪伴, 指南, 升降口围罩\nvt. 陪伴

example.text: The old dog had been his faithful companion for over ten years.
example.translationZh: 这只老狗已经做了他十多年的忠实伴侣。

definitionEn:
n. an institution created to conduct business
n. small military unit; usually two or three platoons
n. the state of being with someone
n. organization of performers and associated personnel (especially theatrical)
definitionZh: n. 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群\nvt. 陪伴\nvi. 交往

example.text: I'll keep you company while you wait for the doctor.
example.translationZh: 你在等医生的时候，我会陪着你。

definitionEn: a. able to be compared or worthy of comparison\ns. conforming in every respect
definitionZh: a. 可比较的, 比得上的

example.text: Her salary is comparable to that of a senior manager.
example.translationZh: 她的薪水与一位高级经理的薪水相当。

definitionEn:
v. examine and note the similarities or differences of
v. be comparable
v. consider or describe as similar, equal, or analogous
v. to form the comparative or superlative form on an adjective or adverb
definitionZh:
vt. 比较, 比喻, 对照
vi. 相比
n. 比较
[计] 比较

example.text: If you compare this year's sales figures with last year's, you can see a clear improvement.
example.translationZh: 如果你把今年的销售数据与去年的相比，就能看出明显的提升。

definitionEn: n. a space into which an area is subdivided\nn. a partitioned section, chamber, or separate room within a larger enclosed area
definitionZh: n. 分隔间, 卧车包房, 防水舱隔\n[医] 隔室, 隔间

example.text: She put her suitcase in the overhead compartment before taking her seat.
example.translationZh: 她在入座前把手提箱放进了头顶的行李舱。

definitionEn:
n. navigational instrument for finding directions
n. the limit of capability
n. drafting instrument used for drawing circles
v. bring about; accomplish
definitionZh: n. 指南针, 范围, 音域\nvt. 包围, 达到, 图谋, 理解

example.text: Finishing the report by Friday is within my compass if I stay focused.
example.translationZh: 如果我保持专注，周五之前完成报告在我的能力范围内。

definitionEn: v. force somebody to do something\nv. necessitate or exact
definitionZh: vt. 强迫, 迫使

example.translationZh: 新的证据迫使陪审团重新考虑他们的裁决。

definitionEn: n. something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury)\nn. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that conceals your undesirable shortcomings by exaggerating desirable behaviors
definitionZh: n. 补偿, 赔偿金, 工资\n[医] 代偿(机能), 补偿

example.text: The court ordered the company to pay compensation for damages caused by the defective product.
example.translationZh: 法院命令该公司支付因缺陷产品造成的损害赔偿金。

definitionEn: n. the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
definitionZh: n. 胜任, 职称, 能力\n[医] 能力, 活性

example.text: The new manager quickly demonstrated her professional competence by reorganizing the team's workflow.
example.translationZh: 新经理通过重新组织团队的工作流程，很快展现了她的专业能力。

definitionEn: n. a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers\nn. the act of competing as for profit or a prize
definitionZh: n. 竞争, 竞赛\n[经] 竞争, 竞销, 比赛

example.translationZh: 小商店面临来自大型超市的激烈竞争。

definitionEn: a. involving competition or competitiveness\ns. subscribing to capitalistic competition\ns. showing a fighting disposition
definitionZh: a. 竞争的\n[经] 竞争的

example.translationZh: 该公司的创新技术使其在全球市场中具有显著的竞争优势。

definitionEn: n. (formerly) a loud cry (or repeated cries) of pain or rage or sorrow\nn. an expression of grievance or resentment\nn. (civil law) the first pleading of the plaintiff setting out the facts on which the claim for relief is based

example.translationZh: 她就隔壁嘈杂的施工向经理提出了投诉。

definitionEn:

v. bring to a whole, with all the necessary parts or elements
v. complete a pass
v. write all the required information onto a form

example.text: She worked late into the night to complete the report before the deadline.
example.translationZh: 她工作到深夜，以便在截止日期前完成报告。

definitionEn:
n. the coloring of a person's face
n. a combination that results from coupling or interlinking
n. a point of view or general attitude or inclination
n. texture and appearance of the skin of the face
definitionZh: n. 肤色, 情况, 局面\n[医] 体质; 面色, 面容

example.text: Her fair complexion made her stand out in the crowd.
example.translationZh: 她白皙的肤色使她在人群中格外显眼。

definitionEn: n acting according to certain accepted standards\nn a disposition or tendency to yield to the will of others\nn the act of submitting; usually surrendering power to another
definitionZh: n. 遵从, 顺从, 屈从\n[化] 柔顺; 顺应

example.text: All factories must operate in compliance with the new safety regulations.
example.translationZh: 所有工厂都必须遵守新的安全法规运营。

definitionEn: s. difficult to analyze or understand

example.translationZh: 在引入新提案后，谈判变得更加复杂了。

definitionEn:
n. the act or process of complicating
n. a situation or condition that is complex or confused
n. any disease or disorder that occurs during the course of (or because of) another disease
n. a development that complicates a situation
definitionZh: n. 复杂化, 复杂情况\n[医] 并发症, 并发病

example.translationZh: 病人在手术后出现了严重的并发症，不得不延长住院时间。

definitionEn: n. a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration\nv. say something to someone that expresses praise\nv. express respect or esteem for
definitionZh: n. 称赞, 恭维, 敬意\nvt. 称赞, 褒扬, 恭维

example.text: She paid her colleague a compliment on his presentation.
example.translationZh: 她称赞了同事的演讲。

definitionEn: v. act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
definitionZh: vi. 顺从, 依从\n[法] 遵守, 承诺, 照做

example.text: All visitors must comply with the safety regulations at the construction site.
example.translationZh: 所有访客都必须遵守施工现场的安全规定。

definitionEn:
v. form the substance of
v. write music
v. put together out of existing material
v. calm (someone, especially oneself); make quiet
definitionZh: vt. 组成, 写作, 作曲, 使平静\nvi. 创作, 排字\n[计] 编写

example.translationZh: 她深吸一口气让自己镇定下来，然后走上舞台。

example.translationZh: 这架飞机的机翼由轻质复合材料制成。

definitionEn:

n. something that is created by arranging several things to form a unified whole
definitionZh: n. 作文, 创作, 组成\n[化] 成分; 组成

example.translationZh: 科学家正在研究土壤的化学成分，以了解农作物如何生长。

example.translationZh: 在上传图片到网站之前，你应该先压缩这些图片。

v. settle by concession
definitionZh: n. 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解\nvi. 妥协处理\nvt. 危害

example.translationZh: 经过数小时的谈判，双方终于在预算上达成了妥协。

definitionEn: s. required by rule
definitionZh: a. 被强制的, 强迫的, 义务的\n[经] 强迫的, 强制的

example.translationZh: 在许多国家，教育是强制性的，直到十六岁。

definitionEn: n. a machine for performing calculations automatically

example.translationZh: 她用电脑为线上课程剪辑视频。

definitionEn: n a machine for performing calculations automatically\nn an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)

example.translationZh: 现代计算机每秒能处理数百万次计算。

definitionEn: v. hold back; keep from being perceived by others

example.translationZh: 她试图向家人隐瞒真相。

definitionEn:

example.translationZh: 最终投票结果统计出来后，这位候选人决定承认失败。

example.text: Proper nutrition is important from conception to birth.
example.translationZh: 从受孕到出生，适当的营养很重要。

definitionEn:

example.text: She clipped a coupon for the laundry detergent and saved two dollars at the store.
example.translationZh: 她剪下了一张某洗衣液的优惠券，在商店省了两美元。

example.translationZh: 她通过快递寄出了签好的合同，以便第二天早上能送到。

example.translationZh: 这学期她在上一门西班牙语课程。

definitionEn: n. a courteous or respectful or considerate act\nn. a courteous or respectful or considerate remark\nn. a courteous manner
definitionZh: n. 礼貌, 谦恭, 好意\n[法] 优待, 礼貌, 恩惠

example.text: It's common courtesy to thank someone who holds the door for you.
example.translationZh: 向为你开门的人道谢是基本的礼貌。

definitionEn:

example.translationZh: 这次选举在所有主要电视网络上得到了广泛的新闻报道。

definitionZh: n. 懦弱的人, 胆小的人

example.translationZh: 他太害怕而不敢发言，所以大家都叫他胆小鬼。

example.translationZh: 警方决定严厉打击学校附近的违章停车。

example.translationZh: 她在这个小镇从出生到去世，从未搬离过。

phrase.text: from the cradle to the grave
phrase.translationZh: 从摇篮到坟墓；从生到死

example.translationZh: 团队花了数周时间精心制定一项减少工厂浪费的计划。

example.translationZh: 大雪导致高速公路上发生了一起严重的车祸。

example.translationZh: 徒步者到达火山口边缘，俯瞰下方的小蓝湖。

definitionEn:
n. a very slow movement

example.translationZh: 婴儿爬过客厅地板，朝她的玩具爬去。

definitionEn:

example.translationZh: 她把信整齐地折好，好让它能毫无褶皱地装进信封里。

phrase.translationZh: 毫无褶皱；没有一丝皱痕

definitionEn:

example.translationZh: 记者在进入新闻发布会前被要求出示证件。

example.translationZh: 陪审团认为这名证人可信，因为她的陈述与物证相符。

example.translationZh: 常春藤会悄悄爬满老建筑的墙壁，直到整个外墙变成绿色。
